skater_rank_basis: The 2026-2027 skill board estimates portable 5v5 on-ice net goals above an ex-ante replacement cohort. Every player receives equal position-specific minutes derived from observed league 5v5 team-state time, so coach deployment alone cannot inflate rank. Player-specific response curves model prior-season opponent tier, pregame and in-game workload, shift and schedule fatigue, zone starts and score state using information available before each stint. Those curves are transported to one common position-specific deployment distribution; difficult usage changes uncertainty and projected role scaling rather than automatically awarding skill. Transport outside a player's demonstrated context range is shrunk and flagged as low-overlap. Shot volume, shot quality, own conversion and teammate conversion are selected independently from causal history. Defense is forecast against a team-season-fixed-effect isolated target, then placed in a position-average xGA and conversion environment. Historical goalie results, team finishing against and raw goal-error residuals cannot persist as neutral player skill. Proj GF/60 and Proj GA/60 are model forecasts in that neutral environment—not raw on-ice results and not standalone defensive grades. Off xGAR/60 and Def xGAR/60 are the individualized above-replacement components. Def xGAR includes possession and exits that prevent defensive-zone exposure; it is not a pure off-puck or defensive-technique grade. Discipline caused at 5v5 is replacement centred and included in total xGAR. Power-play and penalty-kill performance are excluded.
fantasy_rank_basis: The 2026-2027 fantasy board first forecasts NHL appearance, then games conditional on appearing, deployment and category rates. Historical tests retain cutoff-eligible players who record zero following-season games. Category-rate candidates may use workload-standardized isolated skill, response reliability and overlap, but only when they win nested development selection. The exact conditional 5v5 process, own conversion, teammate conversion, defensive conversion and residuals are displayed beside the fantasy scoring decomposition and cutoff-time environment deltas. The default score is 3 per goal, 2 per assist, 0.25 per shot, 0.5 per power-play point, 0.2 per hit and 0.3 per block. Score RMSE is player-equal rolling out-of-sample error with team-season clustered uncertainty, not a confidence interval for one player.
goalie_rank_basis: Shot-stopping and save-based statistics are combined into goalie rankings. Metrics are heavily weighted toward the current season, but use the last 3 seasons to assign certainty. Fits and models are trained solely on data available through the public NHL API. All analysis on this page excludes empty-net goals unless otherwise specified. Metrics are also shrunk based on certainty and stability, so it may take several games for a goalie to be appropriately ranked. Goalies need at least min(10, ceil(10% of an 82-game season)) starts to qualify.
team_rank_basis: On-ice team statistics are combined into attacking, defending, and special teams based statistics. Metrics are heavily weighted toward the current season, but use the last 3 seasons to assign certainty. Fits and models are trained solely on data available through the public NHL API. All analysis on this page excludes empty-net goals unless otherwise specified. Metrics are also shrunk based on certainty and stability, so it may take several games for a team to be appropriately ranked.
underrated_rank_basis: Talent, role, and context statistics are combined into an underplayed score. Metrics are heavily weighted toward the current season, but use the last 3 seasons to assign certainty. Fits and models are trained solely on data available through the public NHL API. All analysis on this page excludes empty-net goals unless otherwise specified. Metrics are also shrunk based on certainty and stability, so it may take several games for a player to be appropriately ranked.

comparison.comparison_contract: Both legacy and new predictions are scored on the same target and the same rows. Legacy published errors against its former target are not treated as comparable.
comparison.pairing_policy: Every metric for both versions is computed on rows scoreable for both versions. Rows only one version can predict are excluded and counted in pairing_coverage rather than charged to the version that did predict them.
comparison.holdout_policy: The final two diagnosed seasons are reported as retired diagnostics and are never used to accept this enhancement.
comparison.justification: Acceptance is based only on pre-holdout rolling development: paired corrected-target RMSE, rank correlation, and a majority of development folds. The retired seasons remain visible even when they disagree.

scoring_anomalies.basis: Minimum 10 total points for point-profile tables and minimum 8 total goals for 5v5 goal-share. Points are derived from season goal events. 5v5 means exact 5 skaters vs 5 skaters with goalies on ice. Power-play points include all man-advantage goal points with a goalie in net. 5v5 + PP can be less than total because shorthanded, 4v4, 3v3, and extra-attacker situations are separate. 1-goal games use the final goal margin from season goal events.

recent_basis: Recent mover lists use custom rating changes versus the 2026-03-27 snapshot, which is the day before the weighted-median 10th most recent team game. Skater movers use overall talent score, team movers use total team score, goalie movers use goalie score, and usage lists compare the most recent 10 games to the previous 10.
